description: Source code for the TunDevicePacketExchanger class, which handles packet exchange over a TUN/TAP device, including reading, writing, and processing Ethernet and IPv6 headers, as well as handling neighbor solicitation responses.

classes.name: TunDevicePacketExchanger
classes.description: Handles packet exchange over a TUN/TAP device, including reading, writing, and processing Ethernet and IPv6 headers, as well as neighbor solicitation responses.

methods.name: WritePacket
methods.description: Writes a packet to the TUN device, applying L2 headers if necessary, and handles blocking and errors.

methods.name: ReadPacket
methods.description: Reads a packet from the TUN device, processes L2 headers, and handles blocking and errors.

methods.name: set_file_descriptor
methods.description: Sets the file descriptor for the TUN device.

methods.name: stats_interface
methods.description: Returns the stats interface associated with this packet exchanger.

methods.name: ApplyL2Headers
methods.description: Adds Ethernet headers to an IPv6 packet for transmission over a TAP device.

methods.name: ConsumeL2Headers
methods.description: Removes Ethernet headers from a received packet, processes neighbor solicitations, and responds if necessary.
